source: Church
target: Ekanisa

source: Church as a family
target: Ekanisa makka

source: When we accept God’s offer and are reborn, we become a member of God’s family. Every spiritual child needs a spiritual family. God is our heavenly father, and as followers of Jesus, we are like brothers and sisters. Family means a safe place to grow and to learn who we are as children of God. Family provides care, and we learn how to live in relationships.
target: Bwetukiliza okwagala kwa Katonda era netuzalibwa bujja, tufuka omu ku makka ga Katonda. Buli mwanna ow'omwoyo yetaga amakka oba family ey'omwoyo Katonda ye kitaffe owomugulu era nga abagobelezi ba Yesu, tulinganga ab'oluganda abalenzi n'abawala. Amakka kitegeza ekiffo ekilunji okukulilamu era n'okuyiga kyetuli nga abaaana ba Katonda. Amakka gabudabuda, era tuyiga butya bwetubelawo munkolagana.

source: Church as a body
target: Ekanisa mubili

source: We are the body of Jesus – that’s how the New Testament describes the relationship between Jesus and His followers. A body means that everyone is a part and has a special role. Jesus is the head; we need to be connected to Him so that He can coordinate everything and lead us. We’re supposed to work together just like a body does. That way we resemble Jesus and He can work through us.
target: Tuli mubili gwa Yesu=eyo yengeri butya endagano empya gy'enyonyola enkolagana wakati wa Yesu n'abagobelezi be. Omubili kitegeza nti buly'omu alikitundutundu eranga ayina omulimu ogwenjawulo. Yesu yemutwe, twetaga okuba nga tugatidwa ku Ye okusobola Ye okubanga akwasaganya bulikimu era n'okutukulembera. Tutekedwa okubanga tukola fenna era nga omubili bwegukola. Mungeri eyo tufanana Yesu era asobola okukola nga ayita muffe.

source: Church as a team
target: Ekanisa nga akakundi

source: A team is a group of people who decide to work together for a common vision. They train together and do whatever is necessary to reach the goal. Jesus wants His church to be united for His kingdom. He shows us who we could build a team with and who should train us.
target: Akakundi kyekibinja ky'abantu abasalawo okukolera awamu kulw'okolesebwa okumu. Batendekebwa wamu era bakola buli ekisana okutuka kunsonga. Yesu ayagala ekanisa Ye okwegata ku lw'obwakabaka bwe. Ye atulaga anni gwetuyinza okuzimba akakundi naye era anni ayinza okututendeka.

source: Therefore it is clear that “church” is not a building, but a group of followers of Jesus. Church can meet anywhere: in parks, schools, cafés, church buildings, offices, at home or online.
target: N'olw'ekyo kilabikiladala nti “ekanisa” si kizimbe, naye akabinja k'abagobelezi ba Yesu. Ekanisa esobola okusisinkana wonna: mu paaka, masomero, kaffezi, mu bizimbe by'ekanisa, mumawofisi, ewakka oba kumikutu.

source: What do the three images of church (as a family, as a body, as a team) look like in your life?
target: Bifanana bitya ebifananyi ebisatu binno eby'ekanisa ( nga amakka, nga omubili, nga akakundi) mu bulamu bwo?

source: Church in the Book of Acts
target: Ekanisa mukitabbo ky'ebikolwa by'abatume

source: In the New Testament, the word “church” is used in three different ways:
target: Mundagano empya, kigambo “kanisa” kikozesebwa mungeriv sattu ezenjawulo:

source: # All the followers of Jesus in the world (the global “body of Christ”)
target: # Abagobelezi bonna aba Yesu munsi yonna (“omubili gwa Yesu” okwetolola ensi)

source:
# All the followers of Jesus in a city / a region
Example: the “church in Jerusalem” (Acts 11:22)
target:
# Abagobelezi ba Yesu bonna mukibuga/ mukitundu
Ekyokugeza: “ekanisa mu Yeluzalemi” (Ebikolwa by'abatume 11:22)

source:
# A group of followers of Jesus that regularly meet together
Example: the “church in the house of Priscilla and Aquila” (Romans 16:5)
target:
# Akabinja k'abagobelezi ba Yesu akatela okusisinkana
Ekyokugeza: “ekanisa mu nyumba ya Pulisila ne Akwila” (Abaluumi 16:5)

source: Here we look at the third meaning. What elements make up a specific church?
target: Wanno tutunulira amakulu ag'okusattu. Bikki ebikola ekanisa?

source: Read Acts 2:37-47.
target: Sooma Ebikolwa by'abatume 2:37-47.

source: Elements of church
target: Ebilagwa mu kanisa

source: Baptism
target: Okubatiza

source:
The word “baptism” means “to immerse, submerge” as cleansing or washing. Just as Jesus was baptised, we join with Him by getting baptized ourselves. Jesus commands His followers:
“... baptise them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.” (Matthew 28:19)
target:
Ekigambo “okubatizibwa” kitegeza “okunyika” nga okutukuza oba okwooza. Nga Yesu bweyabatizibwa, tumwegatako nga naffe tubatizibwa. Yesu alagira abayigilizwa be:
“... mubabatize mulinnya lya Taata n'ery'Omwanna n'ery'Omwoyo omutukuvu.” (Mataayo 28:19)

source: Read Acts 2:38 again, and see how it explains this and shows the main parts of “re-birth”:
target: Sooma Ebikolwa by'abatume 2:38 nate, era labba engeri gyenyonyora kinno nengeri gyelaga ebitundu ebikulu “eby'okuzalibwa omulundi omulala”:

source: We repent and bury our old life. In the same way that Jesus was buried and then rose again to life, we go under water in baptism and come out of the water with a new life (Romans 6:1-11). Then in our new family we start a totally new lifestyle guided by the example of Jesus and filled with the Holy Spirit. (See the worksheet “Baptism” for more details).
target: Twenenya era netuzika obulamu bwaffe obukadde. Mungeri y'emu Yesu gyeyazikibwa aw'oluvanyuma n'azukila nate, mukubatizibwa tuyingira mu mazzi era netugafuluma n'obulamu obupya (Abaluumi 6:1-11). Awo mu famile yaffe empya tutandika obulamu obupya nga bulungamizibwa n'eky'okulabilako kya Yesu eranga bujuzidwa omwoyo omutukuvu. (sooma ku “Okubatizibwa” kubisingawo).

source: The Lord’s Supper
target: Eky'egulo kya Mukama

source: Jesus set the Lord’s Supper so that we remember His death and the shedding of His blood for our sins (Luke 22:15-20). We take time to reflect on what Jesus did for us and to give thanks. When we have it, we should examine our actions and confess our sins (1 Corinthians 11:23-29, see also worksheet “Confessing Sins and Repenting”).
target: Yesu yatekawo eky'egulo ekyo tusobole okujukila okuffaKwe n'okuyuwa kw'omusayi Gwe kulw'ebibi byaffe (Lukka 22:15-20). Tutwala akasera netufumintiliza kw'ekyo Yesu kyeyatukolera era netumwebaza. Nga tukiyina, tutekedwa okutunula mubikolwa byaffe era netwenenya ebibi byaffe (1Abakolinso 11:23-29, labba nate ku “Okwatula ebibi n'okwenenya”).

source: Covenant
target: Omukago

source: A group of people who have been baptised now decides to follow Jesus together. They make a covenant with each other, start to see themselves as a church and commit to doing God’s will together.
target: Akabinja k'abantu ababatizidwa kati basalawo okugobelera Yesu wamu. Batta omukago, nebatandika okwelaba nga ekanisa era nebewayo okukola okwagala kwa Katonda bwonna.

source: Leaders
target: Abakulembeze

source: Healthy churches have leaders who care about the others and support them to do God’s will in all parts of their lives.
target: Ekanisa enunji erinna abakulembeze abafayo eri abalala era nga babayamba okukola okwagala kwa Katonda mubitundutundu by'obulamu bwabwe bwonna.

source: Giving
target: Okuwayo

source: Giving thank-you gifts to God is an act of worship. We offer sacrifices to God in many areas of our life, e.g. with our time and our abilities. God has also asked us to give parts of our finances to Him. This is an important way to give into the family of God – His global, regional and local kingdom.
target: Okuwayo ebilabo eby'okwebaza eri Katonda kimu ku bikolwa eby'okusinza. Tuwayo sadaka eri Katonda mungeri nyinji mubitundu eby'obulamu bwaffe, okugeza obudde bwaffe n'obusobozi bwaffe. Katonda n'era atusabye n'okuwayo ebitundu kubyenfuna zaffe gy'Ali. Enongeri enkulu ey'okuwayo mu makka ga Katonda – mukwetolola, ekitudu, n'obwakabaka bwa bulijjo

source: Worship
target: Okusinza

source: We praise God and are in His presence.
target: Tutendeleza Katonda era mukubelawo Kwe.

source: Fellowship
target: Okukungana

source: We lovingly care about each other and are ready to sacrifice for each other.
target: Tufayo eri abalala mumukwano era nga tulinabetegefu okwesadaka kulw'abalala.

source: Prayer
target: Okusaba

source: Together we talk with God.
target: Ngatuli fenna twogera ne Katonda.

source: Training
target: Okutendekebwa

source: We read the Bible and teach everyone to obey God in everyday life.
target: Tusoma Bayibuli era netusomesa abalala okugondera Katonda mubulamu obwabulijo.

source: Multiplication
target: Okukubisamu

source: We share the gospel and make disciples by the power of the Holy Spirit.
target: Tugabana enjiri era netufula abayigilizwa kulw'amannyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

source: Take time now as a group and evaluate: Which of these elements do you have in your group?
target: Mutwale ekasera kati nga akabinji okwegerageranya: Ki kubilagwa binno byemuyina mukabinja kamwe?

source: What are your next steps so that you can get closer to God’s ideal of church? (What do you need to add? Where do you need to use your time differently? etc.)
target: Dalaki lyemuzako musobole okusembelera endowoza ya Katonda ku kanisa? (Kiiki kyemwetaga okugatako? Ludawa wemwetaga okukozesa obudde mungeri eyenjawulo? n'ebilala.)
